body.name: Observed adaptive Gaussian experiment
body.construction: Fix \(d=(m,q,w)\) satisfying ass:deterministic-partition, ass:predictable-counts, and ass:fixed-overlap-counts. On the fixed measurable spaces \((\mathsf H_b,\mathcal G_b)\), start with the point mass at \(O^{(0)}=\varnothing\). Recursively for \(b=1,\ldots,B\), given \(h\in\mathsf H_{b-1}\), set \(k=q_b(h)\), draw \(z\in\{0,1\}^{m_b}\) from the Borel kernel \[K_b^Z(z\mid h)=\binom{m_b}{k}^{-1}\mathbf 1\!\left\{\sum_{j=1}^{m_b}z_j=k\right\},\] then draw \(y\in\mathbb R^{m_b}\) from \[K_{b,\mu,\sigma}^Y(dy\mid h,z)=\bigotimes_{j=1}^{m_b}\mathcal N(\mu_{z_j},\sigma_{z_j}^2)(dy_j),\] and append \((z_j,y_j)_{j=1}^{m_b}\) to \(h\). The resulting finite Ionescu--Tulcea recursion defines \(P^{d}_{\mu,\sigma}\) on \((\mathsf H_B,\mathcal G_B)\); \(O\) is the identity coordinate, \(Q_b=q_b(O^{(b-1)})\), and \(\mathcal F_b=\sigma(O^{(b)})\). Thus the experiment contains the assignment history and exactly one revealed Gaussian response per unit.
